title: Arakhin 17 - From Rags to Riches—and Back Again

chapters.title: Introduction to Masechet Arakhin Daf Yod Zayin
chapters.about: Review of basic laws of Arakhin and affordability

chapters.title: Comparing Arakhin and Korbanot for a Mesorah
chapters.about: How status affects Arakhin versus a mesorah's sacrifices

chapters.title: Gemara Analysis of the Mishna's Terminology
chapters.about: Examining the phrasing of the Mishna and Scriptural sources

chapters.title: Changes in Financial Status over Time
chapters.about: Rich versus poor status at the time of vowing and paying

summary: Rabbi Hidary goes through the laws of Arakhin and compares them with korbanot for a mesorah. The class examines how affordability, age, and gender apply to vows and sacrifices based on the status of the person making the vow versus the object of the vow.
questions: How does affordability affect an Arakhin vow compared to korbanot for a mesorah?
What happens if someone makes a vow while rich and then becomes poor, or vice versa?
How do the laws of witnesses relate to the continuous status of a person?
What is the difference between making a general oath to a crowd versus singling out witnesses?
